test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

The cake was baked by the chef in the kitchen.

options.text: The kitchen was baking the cake by the chef.
The chef baked the cake in the kitchen.
The cake was being baked by the chef in the kitchen.
The cake is being baked by the chef in the kitchen.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action expressed by the verb.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The chef baked the cake in the kitchen."
 
• To convert from passive voice, place the subject (the chef) before the verb and remove the auxiliary verb "was".
 
• Option 2 correctly uses the active form of the verb, where "the chef" performs the action of baking the cake.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The chef baked the cake in the kitchen."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The kitchen was baking the cake by the chef" – Incorrect because the kitchen is incorrectly used as the subject performing the action.
 
• **Option 3:** "The cake was being baked by the chef in the kitchen" – This is in passive continuous tense, not active voice.
 
• **Option 4:** "The cake is being baked by the chef in the kitchen" – This is in present continuous passive, not active voice.
